text: Faintstep Stoats are ferrets located in at Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound.

Faithless Trappers are Faithless sethrak fighting Defenders of Rakjan atop the Crackling Ridge in Vol'dun. A number of dead Trappers are found in other locations in western Vol'dun, including Dead Man's Pass, Chief Expedition Officer McCormick's camp, and Taz'raka the Traitor's ruins.

Fallen Frostwolf Artifacts are contained in Frostwolf Axes, Frostwolf Collars, and Frostwolf Traveler's Packs in Frostfire Ridge.

Faithful Bloodhounds are mastiffs who accompany Stormsong Marshals in Addington Shipyards in Stormsong Valley.
the Fake Rock is located in the Abandoned Junkheap in Tiragarde Sound.

The Faerie Trove is found at the Path of Rebirth in Ardenweald.

Falir the Shifting is a Wild God soul located in Queen's Conservatory. It is brought back through a wildseed infused with the Shifting Spirit of Knowledge.

Faldo Iscar is a lich of the House of Constructs located inside the Amputory in Maldraxxus. He is a collector of unusual skins, including that of Emeni's construct body, which he keeps in the Faldo's Keepsakes chest next to him. __NOTOC__
Faldo's Keepsakes is a chest located next to Faldo Iscar inside the Amputory in Maldraxxus. It can only be opened using Faldo's Key, dropped by Iscar himself.
Fal'zinge is a lich located on the Exoramas floating above the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Faeflayer is a Drust located in a cave behind a waterfall in the Shrouded Mire in Ardenweald.

Fallen Charger is a Mawhorse that spawns near the active Covenant Assault in the Maw every one-to-six hours. Defeat the charger for a chance at the Fallen Charger's Reins and 5% progress toward Shaping Fate. The charger also drops Splintered Horseshoe and Charger's Armor Spikes.

Fallen Charger's Reins is a Mawhorse ground mount that drops from the Fallen Charger, a rare spawn that appears at the various locations in the Maw and quickly runs through the zone to the border with Korthia.
Fake It 'Til You Make It is awarded to players who complete Tazavesh, the Veiled Market in Hard Mode.
Fallen Avenger's Amice drops from Aggramar in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Fallen Empress's Cord drops from Mordretha, the Endless Empress in the Theater of Pain.
Faewoven Pack is sold by Aithlyn in Heart of the Forest for and Liawyn in Oribos for . Only members of the Night Fae Covenant can purchase this item.
Faeweald Fleshrender is sold by the following vendors for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Sparklebreeze *Adera *Harkoth *Sulanoom

Faithful Footguards are a quest reward from Gurtar's Request.
The Fallen Adventurer's Helm is looted from the Discarded Helm in Tanaan Jungle.
Faithful Dredgers are bigguns encountered by adventure companions in Revendreth.

Failed Colossi are dead automa located at the Plain of Actualization in Zereth Mortis.
Failed Bulwarks are dead automa located at the Plain of Actualization in Zereth Mortis.

The Faerie Lamp is a lamp in Eventide Grove in Ardenweald. It is involved in the process to loot the Elusive Faerie Cache.
Failed Students are ghouls summoned by Darkmaster Gandling in Headmaster's Study in Scholomance.

Failsafe Phylactery can be purchased from Archmage Tarsis Kir-Moldir in Naxxramas for during the Season of Mastery. You must first turn in Book of Deathstones: Failsafe Phylactery to purchase this item.
Falanaar Arcway is located in Falanaar Tunnels in Suramar. The area contains a Leyline Feed and Broodmother Shu'malis.
Falanaar Depths is located in Falanaar Tunnels in Suramar. The area contains a Leyline Feed.

The Fall Conquest was the second esports tournament for World of Warcraft: Classic. It was introduced on 16 September 2020 and took place over three weeks between 3-18 October the same year. It had a prize pool of $12,000 (USD) with it being split between the North America and Europe regions. Using the War Game feature, the tournament places 30 players in a 15v15 Arathi Basin battle.
__NOTOC__ The Falcon Watch Sentinels are a pair of blood elves located next to Martik Tor'seldori in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.
Falconer Gauntlet Drawings are located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Faintly Enchanted Remains are located in the Azure Span. Interacting with the Mana-Starved Crystal Cluster causes it to form into an Enchanted Crystaline Construct, which must be killed to obtain the remains. Only enchanters with 25 points in Dragon Isles enchanting may interact with it.
__NOTOC__ Fael'lin is a blood elf located in Froststone Vault in the Forbidden Reach. He is part of the fire variant of Froststone Vault Primal Storm as the last obstacle.
__NOTOC__ Faera is a green dragon in night elf visage located in Thaldraszus.

Failed Potions of Plague are located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. The imbiber will become Plague Infused, granting the appearance of a slime giant while increasing HP by 300% and decreasing movement speed by 30% for 1,5 minutes.
Faerlina's Sewing Kit is an ingredient for the Makeshift Grappling Hook. The item drops from Grand Widow Faerlina in Naxxramas after obtaining Wards of the Dread Citadel.
Fallen Drake's Bonesplitter drops from the Blight of Galakrond in Dawn of the Infinite.
Failure Disposal Cannon drops from The Vigilant Steward, Zskarn in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Failed Applicant's Footpads drops from The Vigilant Steward, Zskarn in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Faintly Humming Sea Stones is sold by Mrrl in Nazjatar for . Using the item yields a Scrying Stone.
Fallbrush Gauntlets dropped from Kyrak in Upper Blackrock Spire.

The Fallow Sanctuary is the village of a tribe of Lost Ones simply called the "Lost Ones", who live in the Swamp of Sorrows. All the Lost Ones here have been driven mad with homesickness and turned completely feral.
Fankriss the Unyielding, a sand reaver, is the big brother of Kurinnaxx, and the third boss of the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
The Fang of Venoxis is a main handed dagger that provides good bonuses for spell casters.
Fandral's Message is provided as an objective for Grove of the Ancients (quest).
Fangdrip Runners are a pair of Level 48 quality Cloth Shoes that improve Intellect, Stamina, Versatility and Nature Resistance.
Fangtooth is a former Blizzard employee and Community Manager for the US World of Warcraft forums. He "moved onto new pastures" in December 2005.

__NOTOC__ Falrin Treeshaper is a night elf who resides in the library in Dire Maul West. He has a particular hatred of ogres and would love to see them all wiped out because they killed his brother. Farlin Treeshaper can add an enchantment to an Incomplete Banner of Provocation which will make the victim mad with rage and ready to fight.
Faol's Rest is located in eastern Tirisfal Glades, just southwest of the Scarlet Monastery. It serves as the graveyard for those dying in Scarlet Monastery or low-level quests around that place.
Falthrien Academy is an area of southwestern Sunstrider Isle crawling with arcane wraiths. Also here, at the top of the academy, is the Wretched known as Felendren the Banished.
__NOTOC__ Far Seer Mok'thardin is an orc located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
.]] The Fang of the Crystal Spider is a Level 55 quality Dagger that has a chance on hit to slow it's target's casting speed and melee speed.

Items used as a currency for getting Tier 4 set pieces for hunters, mages and warlocks. *Chestguard of the Fallen Hero *Gloves of the Fallen Hero *Helm of the Fallen Hero *Leggings of the Fallen Hero *Pauldrons of the Fallen Hero

Fallen Sky Ridge is a widestretched area of northwestern Hellfire Peninsula populated by dangerous colossi. Its most prominent feature is an enormous red crystal which curiously plummeted from the sky. The truth is that the crystal was purposefully planted into the earth in order to corrupt and summon the colossi with its inherent essence. The blood elves are behind this scheme, with Kael'thas being the ultimate mastermind and culprit.
Faol's Signet of Cleansing drops from Omor the Unscarred in the Hellfire Ramparts wing of Hellfire Citadel on Heroic difficulty.
Fanaticism is a retribution paladin Talent. it increases the crititcal strike of all Judgements and reduces the threat of the paladin as an addition.
The Fang of Vashj drops from Lady Vashj in Serpentshrine Cavern.
__NOTOC__ Fallesh Sunfallow is a blood elf weapon vendor located at Falcon Watch in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Fallen Vindicator's Blade is a quest reward from Source of the Corruption.
Fanged Axe is a quest reward from Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater (quest).
In Family Tree, Cliffwatcher Longhorn asks you to deliver a report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. This quest is a pull into Desolace.

Fallen Rangers are banshees found in Windrunner Spire in the Ghostlands. They used to be high elf rangers in life. During the course of Garrosh Hellscream's trial, Vereesa Windrunner ventured into the Spire and killed the banshees. After Sylvanas killed Varok Saurfang and retreated to the spire, the banshees were seen kneeling to her.
Faltering Silithid Flayers are silithid located in the Barrens. This is one of the mobs spawned during the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event.
Fallenroot Satyrs are satyrs found in the tunnels leading to the entrance of Blackfathom Deeps.
Fallenroot Rogues were satyrs that were once found in the tunnels leading to the entrance of Blackfathom Deeps.
The Fang of Bhag'thera drops from Bhag'thera in Stranglethorn Vale.
Fanggore Worgs are worgs found around and within the Rivenwood of Howling Fjord. They can sometimes aggro people on the road to the Grizzly Hills.
__NOTOC__ Falorn Nightwhisper is a night elf alchemy trainer located at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Falstad Wildhammer's Copper Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran.
Fandral Staghelm's Silver Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ Fangtooth Herring is fished in freshwater areas of lower level zones of Northrend. Especially from Fangtooth Herring Schools.

The Fanggore pack can be found in the Rivenwood in the Howling Fjord. Using a Worg Disguise, players speak with, and eventually help, the former alpha worg, Ulfang, take his leadership back from the mysterious white worg, Garwal.
A Fangtooth Herring School is a School of Fish from which from which the catch rate of Fangtooth Herring is 90%. Fangtooth Herring Schools can be found in the lakes and rivers of Howling Fjord.
Family Values is the fourth story in Warcraft: Legends Volume 2. *Written by Aaron Sparrow *Art by In-Bae Kim *Edited by Troy Lewter

The Fallenroot are a sect of satyrs that inhabit Blackfathom Deeps. They have allied themselves with the Blackfathom naga, Blindlight murlocs, Murkshallow makrura, and Twilight's Hammer cultists that inhabit the area. Following the revamp of Blackfathom Deeps the Fallenroot are nowhere to be seen, thus signifying that the sect was possibly wiped out.
Falls of Ymiron refers to the waterfalls that run down the dam built into the structure of Utgarde Keep, feeding water from Lake Cauldros into Daggercap Bay.
The Fallen Temple of Ahn'kahet is an ancient temple in Ahn'kahet. Herald Volazj can be found here.
The Fang of Oblivion drops from the Assembly of Iron on hard mode and can be looted from the Gift of the Observer after defeating Algalon the Observer in the 25-man version of Ulduar.
__NOTOC__ Fallen Hero's Spirits are ghosts found in Icecrown. They can have a variety of appearances and can be converted to the Scourge by Scourge Converters.
Falwulf was one of the dwarves under Rom's command. He accompanied him on a mission to Grim Batol. His status is currently unknown.

Fanii is a draenei inscription vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Fanii was injured during the Scourge assault at the Argent Tournament Grounds, and Arthur Denny is attempting to mend her.

Falling through the world is a term used to describe the event of falling through the ground of World of Warcraft. Intentionally doing so may be an exploit, but it can also happen unintentionally due to bugs.
Fang of Goldrinn is a quest item for Into the Maw!. It is likely only functional within the Firelands Forgeworks.

These white fangs appear to be a decorative item carved out of ivory or bone. They can, however, be pressed to the underside of existing canine teeth, where they seemingly merge until removed with a command word.
Fallout Cover is a quest reward from Dealing with the Fallout, which begins with Corporal Fizzwhistle just north of the Toxic Airfield in Dun Morogh.

Fang of Lo'Gosh is a quest reward from Into the Maw! It is likely only functional within the Firelands Forgeworks. This item will remain in your inventory after the quest is completed. It can be safely deleted.
Fanged Cloak Pin is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Vrykul Archaeology Fragments to solve, and allows use of two keystones.

The Fallowmere Inn is the inn in the Alliance outpost of Windshear Hold, maintained by Alithia Fallowmere. From here Lord Fallowmere, flanked by Windshear Hold Guardians, looks out over Windshear Crag. The inn also houses the injured, such as Northwatch Captain Kosak.
Fancy Footwork is a quest reward from Dances with Grimtotem.
The Fang of the Wolf is provided as an objective for Perfecting Your Howl.
__NOTOC__ Fandral's Flamescythe drops from Majordomo Staghelm in the Firelands.

Fangs of the Father, Golad, Twilight of Aspects and Tiriosh, Nightmare of Ages, are a pair of legendary daggers for rogues, rewarded by the quest Patricide. The storyline continues the plot of the uncorrupted black dragon egg in the Badlands. Wrathion, a black dragon prince, has hatched from the egg. He offers the legendary quest line to rogues. It will be very time and gold consuming. The quests will involve killing some evil dragons and collecting holy ingredients from the 5-player dungeons as well as the Deathwing raid dungeon. The legendary weapon will have an effect that is designed specifically for rogues.
Fang-she is a sea serpent that can be found in the Singing Pools on the Wandering Isle. She is guarding the Ancient Clam needed for The Sun Pearl.

Fanlin'Deskor (Amber Skies over Wondrous Rock in the Draenei tongue) is the name given to a world by Velen, who witnessed its fall in a vision that he later shared with Anduin Wrynn. The world's real name is unknown as the Burning Legion invaded it and left nothing behind and, according to Velen, "its inhabitants did not speak in ways we understand".
Fallsong Kai are jinyu located in Fallsong Village in Krasarang Wilds.

Fallsong Village is a jinyu village on the Krasarang River just to the south of the Krasari Falls in northwest Krasarang Wilds. The lore object Origins is located in a small temple at the center of the village, Cournith Waterstrider often appears here as well. The village is bordered by the Sentinel Basecamp and the Field of Korja. Dawnchaser Retreat can be found due south.

Fallen Horde Assassins were orc assassins sent on a mission to find and eliminate the elf in charge of the assault on the Mor'shan Rampart. They were, however, killed along with their leader Gorat after the elven leader had been discovered.
Fang Kung, Spark of Titans drops from Will of the Emperor in Mogu'shan Vaults.
Fallsong Om are jinyu located in Fallsong Village in Krasarang Wilds.
Fallen Shieldwall Soldiers can be found at Bilgewater Beach in Krasarang Wilds.
Fan Slowplow is a pandaren found in an inn in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle.
Fangs of the Father - Guild Edition is a guild achievement for having a member with Fangs of the Father.
Far-a-Day Mesh is a quest reward from Batteries Not Yet Included.

Fang'gar was the companion of Jaruk Bloodfyre. When Jaruk and Leena escaped to Zangarmarsh, Fang'gar found them and remained with them. After some time, Fang'gar passed away and was buried. His death saddened Leena.
Fangor is a rare bat located in the hills southeast of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
The Fallen Protectors is the second boss of Siege of Orgrimmar. This trio of bosses is a council encounter where they must be killed together.
Fallen Spiderlords are level 80 crypt lords located in the Court of Bones in Icecrown.
Fallen Humans are human corpses located in the pit in Forsaken Forward Command in Silverpine Forest.
Fallen Pool Tenders are jinyu found in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Falon was a valiant high elf priest who fought in the Third War. He was the older brother of Solanar Bloodwrath.

Fancy Pocket Mirrors can be looted from Blood elves in Ashran.

Fandral's Seed Pouch drops from Majordomo Staghelm in Firelands.

Fallen Horde Soldier is a jungle troll quest giver located at the Lok-rath in .
The Fangs of Ashamane, Fangs of Ashamane (main hand) (main hand) and Fangs of Ashamane (off-hand) (off-hand), are the artifacts used by feral druids in World of Warcraft: Legion.
Fang-Scarred Frostwolf Axe is a common Draenor Clans archaeology artifact, created from 50 Draenor Clans Archaeology Fragments. One Draenor Clan Orator Cane may be used to solve this artifact.
Falthus is a felbat located at the Storm's Eye Overlook in the Maelstrom.

Family Exorcist is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating Master Tamers in the Broken Isles with a full single-type team of each battle pet type.
__NOTOC__ Fanatical Echoes are eredar located at Triumvirate's End in Eredath.
Fallen Marshtide Footmen are humans located in Swamp of Sorrows.
Famished Broken are voidscarred Broken located in the Seat of the Triumvirate.
Fallhaven Ledger is a book located at Fallhaven in Drustvar.
__NOTOC__ Fandral's Pet Carrier is a rare drop from Majordomo Staghelm in the Firelands.
Famished Scourge Trolls are Scourge trolls located in Grizzly Hills.
Fallen Huntmasters are deceased worgen located in Val'sharah, encountered during the Legion Assaults.
Fallen Shotgunners are dead worgen located in Val'sharah, encountered during the Legion Assaults.
Fallen Rectors are deceased Forsaken located in Val'sharah, found during the Legion Assaults.
Falstad's Return is a battleship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .

The Fallrook Estate is a land owned by Terrence Fallrook in Hillsbrad Foothills. Along with an estate, the Fallrook's owned a winery. It was one of the most important economical ventures for Southshore for its wine. Gimp Handyman works here. Following the Forsaken invasion, its status is unclear.
Falls Eels are eels located in the river passing by Fallhaven in Drustvar.
Fallhaven's Curse is a bonus objective offered while in Fallhaven after completing The Vanishing Lord during Signs and Portents and followup quests.
The Fallsong jinyu are based in Fallsong Village in Krasarang Wilds.
Fangs of the First is a Feral druid artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.

The Fallen Outpost was a Zandalari outpost in Nazmir but has since been taken over by the blood trolls on their attack on Zuldazar. During the War Campaign when the Alliance invaded Nazmir, they attacked the Fallen Outpost which was under the control of the Zandalari trolls. Then the Alliance attacked the Blood Gate. When the Zandalari retaliated, the Horde managed to take the eastern part of the outpost and attacked the Alliance in the western part. During these events, the corpses of the previously present blood trolls could be found.
Fallen Paladins are deceased human located in Tirisfal Glades.
Fallout Slimes are oozes located in Naxxramas as a part of the Grobbulus encounter.
Family Brawler is a pet battle achievement earned by winning PvP pet battles with a full single-type team of each battle pet type.
Family Exorcist is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating legendary battle pets on Argus with a full single-type team of each battle pet type.
The Fallen Spider Handaxe is a quest reward from Mistress of Lies.
The Fallen Nation Carver is a quest reward from Containment Procedure.
Fallen Magi's Seerstone drops from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne.

Fangcaller Hrillik is a Faithless sethrak commander normally found circling above Rakjan's Peak in Vol'dun on the back of his pterrordax mount. He and his mount can be pulled to the ground in Forced Grounding.
Fangs of Intertwined Essence drop from the Avatar of Sethraliss in the Temple of Sethraliss.
Fangcaller's Staff is a quest reward from An Explosive Exit.

Family Battler is a Pet Battle meta-achievement that is earned by obtaining all the achievements for defeating 15 Master Tamers on Kul Tiras and Zandalar with level 25 battle pet teams consisting entirely of one family-type, for all family-types. The achievement also rewards the battle pet Wicker Wraith.
Fangcaller Xorreth is a sethrak who appears in a clearing on the southeastern cliffs of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun while the world quest Fangcaller Xorreth (quest) is available.
Fallen Zandalari are undead Zandalari summoned by the tier 15 frost/unholy death knight set.
Fallen Nation Recurve is a quest reward from Containment Procedure.
Family Blades drop from Blood-Crazed Swashbucklers, Plundering Corsairs, and Captain Broketooth in Stormheim.
Fallen Kelp Buds are located at the Spears of Azshara in Nazjatar. Eating them will increase all stats by 5% for 10 minutes.

The Fallen Passage is a non-functioning elevator shaft accessed via the northern area of the Vault of the Wardens. It rises up to the second floor, ending in a small room just before the Demon Ward. When beginning demon hunters proceed to this area, they must use a felbat to ascend the shaft.
Fallen Vanguards were orc bodies picked up from the Vanguard Remains at the Wreck of the Sky Shark in the Jade Forest to be catapulted by the Immobile Catapult.
Fanatical Headhunters are blood trolls located in the Sanctuary of Blood in the Underrot.
Falrevere's estate was Duke Falrevere's home in Kul Tiras before he became the pirate lord of the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
Fang of the Behemoth drops from the Blackwater Behemoth in the Eternal Palace.
Fanged Guardians are abyssal eels summoned by Azsh'ari Tempests and Glacier Mage Zhiela in Nazjatar.

Fallen Riftwalkers are void elves located in the Vision of Stormwind. They are found keeping watch outside the Cathedral of Light. They must be dealt with, before Alleria Windrunner can be engaged in combat.
Fallen Heartpiercers are void elves located in the Vision of Stormwind.
Fallen Voidspeakers are void elves located in the Vision of Stormwind.
Fanatical Pyromancers are eredar located in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Famished Bonepaws are hyenas located in Desolace. They may appear after Swoop Eggs have been placed in an empty Swoop Nest during Early Adoption.
Fallen Taskmasters are void elves located in the Dwarven District in the Vision of Stormwind.

__NOTOC__ The Far Reach is a wetland area located in Nazmir. The brutosaur, Goramor, is in the area for the achievement, Eating Out of the Palm of My Tiny Hand. During the Fourth War, the Alliance landed their decoy force here during the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Falloughue the Hospitable is a dwarf located in Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar.
Fangproof Gauntlets drop from Merektha in the Temple of Sethraliss.
Fallen Scholars are Forsworn kyrian located at the Temple of Humility in Bastion.
__NOTOC__ Famished Etherwyrms are etherwyrms located in southern Bastion.
Fanglings are dredbats located in the Chalice District in Revendreth.
__NOTOC__ Fallen Knowledge-Seekers are Forsworn kyrian located at the Temple of Humility in Bastion.
Famished Fanglings are dredbats located in the Grove of Terror in Revendreth. They can be found feasting on the remains of Humbling Soulwatchers and Drained Soulstalkers.
Fang of Nemaeus drops from Nemaeus at the Aspirant's Crucible in Bastion.
